# ServiceHub Kenya

> ServiceHub Kenya (https://servicehub.co.ke) is a free online marketplace that connects people who need a service with service providers near them, across all 47 counties of Kenya. It covers formal and informal (jua kali) work: plumbers, electricians, mechanics, boda boda riders, barbers and salons, mama mbogas, food kiosks, caterers, cleaners, tutors, movers, photographers and many more. It is free for clients and providers, with no fees or commissions.

ServiceHub Kenya is run by ServiceHub Kenya Limited, a product of Jatelo Technologies, based in Kisumu, Kenya.

## How it works

- **Find a provider near you:** open Find Services → Services near me. ServiceHub uses your location and lists providers nearest first (within 10 km by default), showing how far away each one is, their starting price and their area.
- **Browse all services:** Find Services → All services, filtered by service type and county. The service filter understands everyday words such as "kinyozi" (barber), "fundi wa simu" (phone repair) and "mjengo" (construction work).
- **Post a job and get quotes:** describe the job, location and budget; providers near you send quotes; you compare, accept one, and track the job to completion.
- **Contact:** in-app chat, in-app voice and video calls, WhatsApp, Relay (Jatelo's own messaging app) or a normal phone call. Phone numbers are shown only to signed-in users.
- **Payment:** clients pay the provider directly (cash, M-Pesa or bank). ServiceHub does not handle money and takes no commission.
- **Offer a service:** anyone can list a service free: what they do, price, phone number and a map pin of where they work. A provider working from home can show only the approximate area (about 1 km).
- **One account, two roles:** the same account can hire (client) and work (service provider).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://servicehub.co.ke/): overview, how it works, FAQ and the Android app
- [All service types](https://servicehub.co.ke/services): directory of every service category with providers listed
- [Service type page](https://servicehub.co.ke/services/plumbing): example category page; each lists live providers, prices and areas
- [Android app](https://servicehub.co.ke/download/android): free download of the ServiceHub Kenya app (APK)
- [Sitemap](https://servicehub.co.ke/sitemap.xml): every public page, including each provider's service page

## Facts

- Coverage: all 47 counties of Kenya
- Price to use: free for clients and providers; no commission
- Platforms: website (servicehub.co.ke) and Android app
- Languages: English; common Swahili and Sheng service words are understood in search
- Company: ServiceHub Kenya Limited, a product of Jatelo Technologies, Tom Mboya, Kisumu, Kenya
- Contact: support@servicehub.co.ke, info@servicehub.co.ke, +254 724 090 067, WhatsApp +254 727 679 997
